translations.web: They conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of Yahweh’s house.
translations.bsb: But they conspired against Zechariah, and by order of the king, they stoned him in the courtyard of the house of the LORD.
translations.kjv: And they conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of the house of the LORD.
